Shadowed CBD asphalt is navy (30,41,63), B/R 2.1, in street_sgt and shops, and the lawn in shops is (22,37,37). Shadowed pavers in hero stay brown (45,35,33), where the bible asks for blue-grey #46526A. GTA VI canyons are neutral blue-grey at luma 60-90.

Facades left unlit at night are still pale-grey daylight slabs (87,90,103 against sky 17,33,74). The noon pavers are a pale checkerboard (133,133,136).
gaps.palette: hero paletteDE improved to 17.1 and shops to 12.6. Off-bible areas remain: navy streets (street_sgt sat 0.388), lavender-grey water in hero (98,89,90) where the bible wants #2A566E teal, and the near-white paver hot-spot (246,226,192) right of the player, which is the brightest value in the frame (avoid list: pure white pavers).
gaps.materials: Most of the close architecture is still placeholder. Shopfronts are flat grey glass panels (117,120,124) with colour bars (street_sgt right, shops left). Office glass shows per-cell pale blind squares (street_sgt left). The EQ coping in hero_back is still a flat 6 cm pale wedge, not the rounded limestone seat edge in tricia1. The real EQ ground is small granite setts in fan arcs (tricia1); the game uses large 0.6x0.3 m stretcher pavers.
gaps.vegetation: Close up it is now good: the street_sgt and shops avenues are back, the palm streamers are gone, and Kings Park close range is a convincing eucalypt canopy. From range the scarp is still bald. mends hill reads (141,140,148), the same as r3, and the aerial west plateau is grey (126,122,126). kpview shows a dark olive mass.
gaps.architecture: bridge_skyline and river_cbd have convincing crowns and spires and a varied skyline. In aerial, low-rise blocks are untextured cream boxes with no roof plant. Far towers collapse to flat colour with no floor striping or base-to-crown gradient. Shop podiums have no awnings or depth.
gaps.characters: The player is clean, with no clipping or speckle, but her back-lit luma is 42.2 in hero (r3: 49.6) and 47.7 in phone_hud, so the black hoodie reads as a silhouette. Only one distant pedestrian is in the hero frame, and street_sgt and shops have none.
gaps.composition: The arches are now unobstructed (pole moved to x 0.81), and the quay edge leads cleanly to the EQ Bridge. But about 45% of hero is empty paver, and the brightest value is the paver sun pool, not the arches or the player. r3's framing palms and bench have gone, so there is no foreground depth layer.
gaps.atmosphere: river_cbd, kings_park and aerial show good aerial perspective and sky. From mends the CBD is a ghost: skyline (167,162,166) against sky (167,165,173), with no value separation, where kpview shows dark glass silhouettes.
gaps.ui: The HUD is clean and legible: minimap, location banner over sky, clock and cash. The full-opacity health and stamina bars sit over the far shore in phone_hud (calm fade needs 4 s), and the left thumb area has no movement affordance.
gaps.mobile: Framing is clean (no ped or palm in the near field), and tris fell from 3.73M to 2.25M. Still missing: a joystick ghost, a faster bars calm on touch, and the last 0.25M tris to reach the 2.0M target. Player luma 47.7 is borderline.
gaps.artefacts: No ped clipping, z-fighting or floating meshes this round. Remaining: the black night foreground hole (hero_night), terrain terracing on the aerial west plateau, the flat coping wedge (hero_back), and the blank grey shelter panel at the jetty end (mends) that reads as a missing texture.
gaps.real_game: river_cbd and kings_park could pass as game screenshots. hero, street_sgt and shops read as an empty test level: one car-free boulevard, one ped and an empty plaza. This lived-in gap is now the largest single tell.

fixes.problem: The r4 sightOK filter (props.js line 205-206) deleted the promenade lamp in the spawn-to-bridge sightline. The lamp light map (props.js lines 212-229) only splats lampM, so the plaza around the player lost its only light pool. hero_night bottom-left went from (73,63,54) in r3 to (4,4,5), and luma_p5 from 11.6 to 3.0. The player now stands on a black void at 21:30, and the bible's lampsCastLight rule fails.
fixes.fix: In the EQ promenade loop, push lamps that fail sightOK into a ghostLamps list instead of dropping them. Splat ghostLamps into uLampMap with the same Gaussian, so the light stays and the pole goes. Also move the ghost pool 2 m landward of the shore line so it lands on the pavers, not the water. Alternatively, place the skipped lamp 6 m along the shore (alongShore offset), outside the 3 m sightline corridor. Promenade lamp sigma 5.2 -> 6.0 so the pools overlap at 17 m spacing.

fixes.problem: Asphalt in tower shadow is still (30,41,63) with B/R 2.1 in street_sgt, and (30,38,59) in shops. The footpath is (47,58,80). The upper-hemisphere desaturation helped (from 14,27,52), but the grade still stacks blue on blue: splitShadow 1.13 on blue, sat 1.15 at el 20. The env zenith at el 20 is [0.05,0.14,0.40]. Target is neutral blue-grey, about (55,58,66).
fixes.fix: art.js grade.splitShadow [0.87,0.98,1.13] -> [0.93,0.99,1.05]. sky.js env branch: upper-hemisphere mix factor 0.6 -> 0.4 (more desaturated fill). daycycle.js K el20 sat 1.15 -> 1.06, el45 sat 1.02 -> 0.98. K el20 env 1.15 -> 1.3, so the shadow value rises as the hue neutralises. Re-measure street_sgt before touching asphalt albedo.

fixes.problem: The r4 hero has one distant pedestrian and no bench, palm or prop in the near field. r3 had 4 peds, a bench and two framing palms. The spawn palm exclusion (props.js line 179, hypot > 9 m) and the lamp/bench coupling in sightOK (bench is only placed when its lamp survives) emptied the frame. street_sgt and shops still have zero cars and zero peds, because traffic.js still rejects spawns under 70 m and over 300 m (line 37), and prime() (line 107) does not bias to the camera. Lived-in is a bible mood item and now the biggest demo tell.
fixes.fix: (1) props.js line 179: replace the radial 9 m palm exclusion with a camera-corridor test. Reject only points within 2.5 m of the segment from the spawn back 6 m along -view (where the shot camera sits) and points inside sightOK's corridor. Palms at 10-16 m camera-left and right then frame the shot. (2) props.js line 206: place the bench even when the lamp is skipped (decouple the bi++ bench from the lampM push). (3) traffic.js T.prime: spawn(near, true) in a 20-160 m band with dot(forward) > 0 for at least 60% of T.target. peds.js: prime 10 peds within 12-50 m of focus on the promenade at spawn.

fixes.problem: Shadowed pavers in hero are still (45,35,33): R > G > B, brown, where the bible shadow tint is #46526A. At el 8.9 the env lower hemisphere is warmed by col * vec3(1.08,1.0,0.9) (sky.js env branch), on top of the warm horizon [0.88,0.52,0.30]. The shadow side of everything gets orange bounce.
fixes.fix: sky.js env branch: lower-hemisphere multiplier vec3(1.08,1.0,0.9) -> vec3(0.96,0.98,1.0). art.js sky.groundTint [0.26,0.24,0.22] -> [0.22,0.23,0.24]. In the env bake only, desaturate the near-horizon band (|rd.y| < 0.15) by 0.5, so the warm sunset ring does not dominate the diffuse fill.

fixes.problem: Not landed for the second round. mends hill (141,140,148) is identical to r3, and the aerial west plateau is (126,122,126) grey with terracing. kpview shows the scarp as dark olive canopy. Clump fade on high is [1100,1500] and the bush floor stays sand-grey beyond it.

fixes.area: shopfronts read as flat grey panels
fixes.problem: Street-level shop glass in street_sgt and shops is a uniform (117,120,124) grey: the env reflection dominates. The interior is computed (depth 4.5) but by day it only emits room * 0.9 * lampC * 0.45 * transK, with transK = (1-Fr)*(1-slab)*0.55. These are the closest buildings a player sees.
fixes.fix: facade.js line 182, shop branch: day factor (0.45 + 2.6*uNight) -> (1.1 + 2.0*uNight). facade.js line 192: transK multiplier 0.55 -> 0.85 when shop > 0.5. Shop glass value gl *= 0.6 (darker, less mirror). Add a 0.6 m awning slab over shop bays (towers.js, one merged geometry per building) for the shadow line.
